features.description: A separate bar sets Wild count each round; they occupy the three centre reels, up to nine at once.

features.title: Temple Spins
features.description: Temple Scatters inside the bonus open a wheel for 1–6 extra Free Spins and can trigger repeatedly.

intro: Grand Gold Edition raises Sizzling Eggs' top win to 3000x with extreme volatility. The Collector collects Bonus values during Free Spins and pays the accumulated amount at the end of the sequence.
Collect to Infinity keeps particular collectors active until the bonus finale, while Chance Level allows the bet to increase up to x10 for more frequent Free Spins.
wazdan-sizzling-eggs-grand-gold-edition.editorial: Gold Edition should not be assigned Platinum's Cash Out: the gold release's official page lists Collector, Collect to Infinity and Free Spins but does not separately name Cash Out.

features.title: Collector pays at the bonus end
features.description: Bonus symbol values collect throughout Free Spins rather than necessarily paying on every spin.

features.title: Collect to Infinity
features.description: Extends collection of prize values by the corresponding Collector until the bonus ends.

features.title: Chance Level up to x10
features.description: Paying for a more probable bonus costs more and guarantees no 3000x.

intro: Legacy of Undead Dragon ABYSSWAYS starts on a 6×4 grid. Haunted Gold Coins can awaken the dragon and award an Instant Prize, while Dragon's Wrath on a non-winning round triggers a full respin and expands the grid to 6×6.

During Free Spins, Fire Wilds created by the dragon become Sticky and increase their win multiplier by +1 after every spin. Abyssways changes reel height: marked bottom symbols disappear, then a new full row is added above.
playn-go-legacy-of-undead-dragon-abysswa.editorial: The 6×4 → 6×6 expansion and Abyssways operate under different rules: Dragon's Wrath increases the grid, while Abyssways during Free Spins cyclically removes bottom symbols and adds a new row.

features.title: Dragon's Wrath
features.description: On a non-winning round, the dragon can award a full respin, expand the grid from 6×4 to 6×6 and add random Fire Wilds.

features.title: Sticky Fire Wilds
features.description: During Free Spins, Fire Wilds created by the dragon lock and receive +1 to their win multiplier after every spin.

features.title: Abyssways
features.description: Marked bottom symbols disappear after a spin, reducing reel height, then a new full row is added above.

intro: Grand Platinum Edition raises the maximum award to 4000x and introduces base-game Cash Out to this branch for the first time. Five reels and five lines remain unchanged.
During Free Spins, the Collector continues collecting Cash and Jackpot values, while Collect to Infinity retains it until the bonus ends.
wazdan-sizzling-eggs-grand-platinum-edit.editorial: The platinum version should be separated from Gold: Cash Out appears outside the bonus, RTP differs (96.11% versus 96.16%), and the overall maximum win rises to 4000x.

features.title: Cash Out in the base game
features.description: Prize money values can collect before entry into Free Spins.

features.title: Collector with a limited lifetime
features.description: A landed Collector operates for a specified Countdown, after which accumulated money values pay.

features.title: Collect to Infinity
features.description: Enhances the Collector for the entire bonus duration without turning 4000x into a guaranteed result.

intro: Legend of the Ice Dragon is a cascading grid slot: winning chains continue through falling new symbols rather than a full grid reset after every result.

Its three named freezing features are Hailstorm, Avalanche and Blizzard. They provide different ways to enhance the current round, while Ice Dragon attacks add separate events above the cascade structure.
playn-go-legend-of-the-ice-dragon.editorial: This game is best read as a grid/cascade record rather than a regular line slot: Hailstorm, Avalanche and Blizzard are embedded in successive changes to one grid.

features.title: Cascading grid
features.description: After winning events, the grid continues changing through cascades rather than beginning each result with a completely new independent layout.

features.title: Hailstorm, Avalanche and Blizzard
features.description: Three named freezing features intervene in the grid differently and enhance the current chain.

features.title: Ice Dragon events
features.description: Tail Lash, Ice Scorch, Destruction and Dragon Blast act as separate dragon events during play.

intro: Sizzling Kingdom: Bison presents six reels and ten lines as an animal world, where four bison Wild sizes can cover up to four positions. Beyond regular payouts, it has three bonus branches.
Hold the Jackpot, Free Spins with Collect to Infinity, and Wild Rampage with Hold & Collect differ in their accumulation mechanisms. They should not be described as one general bonus.
wazdan-sizzling-kingdom-bison.editorial: Sizzling Kingdom: Bison's distinction is the choice between different bonuses, including the new Wild Rampage. The stated 5000x is the game limit rather than a separately confirmed bison Wild multiplier.

features.title: Bison Wild in four sizes
features.description: Substitutes for standard symbols and can occupy up to four vertical cells.

features.title: Wild Rampage + Hold & Collect
features.description: An independent bonus holds and accumulates prize values under its own rules.

features.title: Free Spins and Hold the Jackpot
features.description: The other two branches use Collect to Infinity; Buy Feature allows several entry levels.

intro: The original Legion Gold connects Mega Free Spins and Gold Re-Spins through a Mega Coin. Three or more Lion Scatters trigger Mega Free Spins, where a large Mega Symbol can appear on the reels.
Six Coins or a Mega Coin trigger Gold Re-Spins. The sequence starts with three lives: a spin without a new coin takes a life, while a new coin helps collection continue.
playn-go-legion-gold.editorial: The first Legion Gold uses three lives as a pressure counter within Gold Re-Spins. Later versions change collection details, so this mechanic should not automatically be carried into sequels.

features.title: Mega Free Spins
features.description: Three or more Lion Scatters trigger Free Spins with a Mega Symbol that can appear on the reels.

features.title: Gold Re-Spins
features.description: Six Coins or a Mega Coin trigger a Multiplying Wild Coin collection mode.

features.title: Three lives
features.description: Gold Re-Spins starts with three lives; a spin without a coin reduces their number and brings the feature closer to ending.

intro: Sizzling Moon has sixteen positions without traditional lines. Six Bonus symbols trigger Hold the Jackpot; before that, Sticky Bonus symbols can stay on the grid for up to nine respins.
Filling the whole grid awards Grand Jackpot 1000x, while a rare Moon Mystery Symbol can open Moon Jackpot 2500x. These are different prizes even though both occur within one bonus.
wazdan-sizzling-moon.editorial: The maximum win of 2500x should not be replaced with the standard Grand's amount or a sum: 1000x is only the full-grid prize, while 2500x refers to the special Moon Jackpot.

features.title: Six Bonus symbols trigger Hold the Jackpot
features.description: Before triggering, Sticky Bonus symbols stay on the grid for up to nine respins, helping collect six symbols.

features.title: Grand 1000x for a full grid
features.description: Filling all sixteen positions awards a separate Grand on top of the other money values.

features.title: Moon Mystery and 2500x
features.description: A special Mystery Symbol is tied to Moon Jackpot; Buy Feature allows extreme bonus volatility to be selected.

intro: Legion Gold and the Sphinx of Dead triggers Gold Re-Spins after six Gold Coins. Coins remain locked, a new Coin resets the counter, and a full grid is tied to a 1000x multiplier.
Three or more Scatters open Mega Free Spins with a moving 3×3 Mega Symbol. If it becomes a 3×3 Gold Coin, Gold Re-Spins starts immediately with nine coins.
playn-go-legion-gold-and-the-sphinx-of-d.editorial: The Egyptian version differs from neighbouring Legion Gold games through more than decoration: a 3×3 Mega Coin can send the player directly from Mega Free Spins into Gold Re-Spins with nine starting coins.

features.title: Gold Re-Spins
features.description: Six Gold Coins trigger hold-and-respin; coins lock, a new Coin resets the counter, and a full grid awards 1000x.

features.title: Mega Free Spins
features.description: Three Scatters award a bonus with a moving 3×3 Mega Symbol; a Mega Gold Coin can become nine coins and trigger Gold Re-Spins.

features.title: Gold Bag
features.description: In the base game and Mega Free Spins, the Gold Bag collects all visible Gold Coin values and immediately pays their sum.

intro: Slot Jam uses four reels and nine lines, activating Cascading Reels after winning combinations. The jam Wild substitutes for regular fruit and can double the qualifying prize.
A Mystery Basket of three or more baskets awards a random win up to 200x, while Scatter Cake triggers 15 or 30 Free Spins; a matching-fruit wall awards a separate x2.
wazdan-slot-jam.editorial: Slot Jam should not be reduced to ‘fruit + Wild’: Mystery, cascades and the x2 wall form three different payout sources. The whole game's maximum win is 570x.

features.title: Cascading Reels
features.description: Winning symbols disappear and new ones fall from above, potentially continuing the chain within the same spin.

features.title: Mystery Basket up to 200x
features.description: Three or more baskets open a separate random money prize.

features.title: Scatter Cake and wall x2
features.description: Cakes trigger 15/30 Free Spins, while a matching-fruit wall doubles its payout.

intro: Legion Gold and the Throne of Dead adds a Coin Chest to the series: Gold Coins that did not trigger Gold Re-Spins or Golden Scales enter a separate collector.

Once the Coin Chest opens fully, a Picker Game with an Instant Prize begins. Three Scatters trigger Mega Spins, with a Mega Symbol on every spin and a Mega Gold Coin capable of opening Gold Re-Spins again.
playn-go-legion-gold-and-the-throne-of-d.editorial: Throne of Dead should be separated from Sphinx of Dead: Coin Chest with its Picker Game becomes separate progression here, while Mega Spins retains entry into Gold Re-Spins through a Mega Gold Coin.

features.title: Coin Chest Picker Game
features.description: Gold Coins outside the main triggers accumulate in the Coin Chest; an opened chest starts picking until an Instant Prize matches.

features.title: Mega Spins
features.description: Three Scatters trigger Mega Spins with a Mega Symbol at a random position on every spin and retriggers possible.

features.title: Mega Gold Coin
features.description: During Mega Spins, a large Gold Coin can split into Coins and move the game into Gold Re-Spins.

intro: Sonic Reels offers six reels and 729 ways to win. Three, four, five or six Scatters award 10, 15, 20 and 25 Free Spins respectively.
Its two speaker bonuses work differently: Right Speaker can shift 1–3 reels left after an empty spin, while Left Speaker shifts the grid right after a win and increases the multiplier up to x5.
wazdan-sonic-reels.editorial: The Speaker name should not obscure their different algorithms. Both bonuses can activate together and even during Free Spins, but x5 belongs to the left speaker rather than the overall maximum payout of 5400x.

features.title: Right Speaker shifts after an empty spin
features.description: Five right-speaker symbols activate a chance to shift 1–3 reels left and reveal additional symbols.

features.title: Left Speaker builds x5
features.description: After a win, the grid shifts right, new symbols appear, and the multiplier grows up to x5.

features.title: Free Spins 10/15/20/25
features.description: Three to six Scatters award the corresponding sequences; both speaker bonuses can continue operating.

intro: Legion Gold Reckoning retains six-Gold-Coin collection for Gold Re-Spins but adds Coin Chest and Picker Game. Coins outside re-spin mode accumulate in the chest, and a fully opened chest starts picking until three prize coins match.
Three Scatters award five Mega Spins with a Mega Symbol on every spin. A separate GO Ultra toggle changes Animal Symbol frequency and adds boosts at the start of Mega Spins and Gold Re-Spins.
playn-go-legion-gold-reckoning.editorial: Reckoning distinguishes itself from preceding games through GO Ultra and full Coin Chest progression. It is more than a Gold Bag variation: accumulated coins can lead to a standalone Picker Game.

features.title: Gold Re-Spins
features.description: Six Gold Coins trigger a mode in which coins lock and a new Coin resets the re-spin counter; a Gold Coin Bag collects current values.

features.title: Coin Chest and Picker Game
features.description: Coins outside Gold Re-Spins fill the chest; after it opens, the player picks until three coins match and receives an Instant Prize tier.

features.title: Mega Spins and GO Ultra
features.description: Three Scatters award five Mega Spins with retriggers possible, while GO Ultra adds separate boosts to the base game and bonus starts.

intro: Space Gem uses six reels and ten lines with space-themed gemstones. Its Wild both substitutes for regular symbols and expands across an entire reel.
The expanding Wild activates a Re-Spin in which its fully occupied reel remains locked. Wazdan's page lists no Scatter Free Spins.
wazdan-space-gem.editorial: Space Gem's main combination is an Expanding Wild plus a free Re-Spin with holding. Space Pile or UFO Scatter from separate Space Spins should not be carried over.

features.title: Wild expands across an entire reel
features.description: A landed Wild can cover a whole column and participate in line combinations.

features.title: Re-Spin with holding
features.description: The reel containing an expanded Wild stays in place during an additional spin.

features.title: Adjustable volatility and Gamble
features.description: Wazdan separately lists risk-profile selection and an opportunity to risk an amount already won.

intro: Legion Gold Unleashed triggers Gold Re-Spins with six Gold Coins: the first six stay in place, the sequence receives three initial re-spins, and every new Coin adds another attempt.
Three Scatters open Mega Free Spins with a moving 3×3 Mega Symbol. The Gold Bag instantly collects all visible Instant Win values in the base game and Free Spins.
playn-go-legion-gold-unleashed.editorial: Unleashed shifts focus from the original's life system to classic reset/additional re-spins and Gold Bag. A full grid in Gold Re-Spins is tied to a 1000x multiplier, but the confirmed overall maximum win in the lookup is higher and stored separately.

features.title: Gold Re-Spins
features.description: Six Gold Coins trigger three initial re-spins; coins remain held, and each new landing adds another attempt.

features.title: Mega Free Spins
features.description: Three or more Scatters trigger a bonus with a 3×3 Mega Symbol; a Mega Gold Coin can open Gold Re-Spins immediately with nine coins.

features.title: Gold Bag
features.description: The Gold Bag collects all visible Instant Win values in the base game or Mega Free Spins and immediately pays their sum.

intro: Space Spins takes six reels and forty lines into a space battle. Three UFO Scatters trigger 10 Free Spins, while more Scatters can raise the sequence to 25.
During Free Spins, Space Pile randomly selects a symbol that can cover entire reels. The star Wild substitutes for standard symbols except Scatter.
wazdan-space-spins.editorial: Space Spins' technical Game Info lists a maximum of 1650x, although one promotional text rounds the award to 1600x. The record uses the specific figure of 1650x.

features.title: UFO Scatter opens 10–25 spins
features.description: Three UFOs start ten Free Spins; a larger count increases the number up to 25.

features.title: Space Pile
features.description: A selected symbol expands across a whole reel during the bonus, increasing qualifying matches.

features.title: Star Wild
features.description: Substitutes for other regular symbols on forty lines but is not a Scatter.

intro: Legion Gold Victory! combines Gold Re-Spins, Mega Free Spins and Instant Prize Coins. Gold Re-Spins holds coins and updates the grid as collection progresses, while a filled grid is tied to a 1000x prize.
During Mega Free Spins, 3×3 Mega Symbols move across the reels. Instant Prize Coins carry their own values, while a Gold Bag collects them into the combined result.
playn-go-legion-gold-victory.editorial: Victory! brings familiar series elements into one record, but its distinct layer is Instant Prize Coins. They should be separated from regular Gold Coins because the Gold Bag specifically acts as a value-collection mechanism.

features.title: Gold Re-Spins
features.description: Coins trigger a hold-and-spin mechanic; new landings continue collection, while a full grid is tied to a 1000x prize.

features.title: Mega Free Spins
features.description: Large 3×3 Mega Symbols move across the reels during Free Spins, forming a separate bonus scenario.

features.title: Instant Prize Coins and Gold Bag
features.description: Instant Prize Coins carry predetermined values, while the Gold Bag collects them and adds them to the final payout.

intro: In Spectrum, gemstones land on five reels with ten lines. A Wild can expand across a whole column, with expansion opening an additional Respin.
During the re-spin, the expanded Wild retains its position, creating a chance of new combinations; this mechanic should not be confused with jackpot accumulation.
wazdan-spectrum.editorial: Spectrum and Space Gem share Expanding Wild + Respin similarities but use different grids: five reels and ten lines versus six. Spectrum's official ceiling is 500x.

features.title: Expanding Wild
features.description: The Wild substitutes for standard gem symbols and expands across an entire reel.

features.title: Respin retaining the Wild
features.description: An additional spin holds the corresponding expanded Wild on its original reel.

features.title: Gamble up to seven attempts
features.description: A separate opportunity to double an awarded prize is available after a win.

intro: Leprechaun goes Egypt uses up to 20 paylines and separates three special-symbol roles. The Leprechaun acts as a Wild, substitutes for regular symbols and doubles wins in which it participates.
Three Cleopatra Scatters trigger Free Spins with a multiplier-profile choice, while three Pyramid symbols open a separate Bonus Round with door choices and an urn search.
playn-go-leprechaun-goes-egypt.editorial: The two bonuses should remain distinct: Cleopatra leads to Free Spins, Pyramid to a separate pick branch along pyramid corridors, while the Leprechaun remains a multiplier Wild.

features.title: Leprechaun Wild x2
features.description: The Wild substitutes for regular symbols except Bonus and Scatter and doubles a winning line it helps form.

features.title: Cleopatra Free Spins
features.description: Three Cleopatra symbols in scatter positions open Free Spins with a prize-enhancement choice.

features.title: Pyramid Bonus
features.description: Three Pyramids trigger a separate bonus involving door choices, urn collection and the risk of ending the journey by meeting a mummy.

intro: Sun of Fortune uses sixteen positions instead of classic lines: eight matching symbols award a base payout. The Wild substitutes for any regular symbol except Bonus.
Three to five golden Bonus symbols can lock for an additional respin, while six trigger Hold the Jackpot. A complete fill awards Grand 1000x, while Game Info's overall maximum is 1450x.
wazdan-sun-of-fortune.editorial: The distinction between Grand 1000x and overall maximum win 1450x is essential: the former pays for filling the grid, while the latter describes the whole game's theoretical ceiling.

features.title: Eight matching symbols
features.description: A money combination forms anywhere on the matrix rather than along a line.

features.title: Six Bonus symbols trigger Hold the Jackpot
features.description: Three to five Bonus symbols lock for a respin, while six open the accumulation round.

features.title: Grand 1000x for a complete fill
features.description: A full bonus matrix awards Grand alongside accumulated values and other Jackpots.

intro: Leprechaun Goes Wild uses 20 paylines and assigns each reel its own Leprechaun Wild. The Wild substitutes for regular symbols only in its column.
Two Clover Scatters trigger Luck of the Irish: the feature either adds a Wild to every reel or creates a third Scatter and moves into Free Spins. Leprechaun Wilds become Sticky during Free Spins.
playn-go-leprechaun-goes-wild.editorial: This instalment centres on five reel-specific Leprechauns rather than one roaming Wild. Luck of the Irish bridges two Scatters and the complete Free Spins trigger.

features.title: Five reel-specific Wilds
features.description: Each Leprechaun handles its own reel and substitutes for regular symbols to form combinations on 20 paylines.

features.title: Luck of the Irish
features.description: Two Clover Scatters award either five extra Wilds, one per reel, or a third Scatter to trigger Free Spins.

features.title: Sticky Wild Free Spins
features.description: Three Scatters trigger Free Spins; landed Leprechaun Wilds lock until the sequence ends, and the bonus can retrigger once.

intro: Super Hot returns to a three-reel fruit machine with five lines and one prominent mechanic—x2 Wall Multiplier. It doubles a win from a qualifying grid fill.
A separate Unique Gamble Feature allows up to seven risks with an awarded prize for a double, without changing the base spin structure.
wazdan-super-hot.editorial: Super Hot does not belong to Hold the Jackpot despite its fiery presentation. Wazdan lists a maximum of 340x and medium volatility, while x2 is only the wall multiplier.

features.title: Wall with x2 Multiplier
features.description: A qualifying matching-symbol wall doubles the win under a special rule.

features.title: Three reels and five lines
features.description: Regular combinations pay across classic five lines without Free Spins.

features.title: Gamble up to seven doubles
features.description: A separate risk game follows a win; the prize being risked can be lost.

intro: Leprechaun's Diamond Dig builds its round around two minecarts above the reels. When a leprechaun appears, the corresponding Lucky Minecart activates and collects Diamond symbol values beneath it.
If both active carts meet above one reel, Mega Blast triggers and collects Diamonds from all five reels. Three or more Leprechaun Scatters award 10 Free Spins, with both carts permanently active.
playn-go-leprechauns-diamond-dig.editorial: Diamond Dig's main progression lies within Free Spins: Lucky Clovers charge the Mega Blast meter while adding spins, so bonus multiplier and duration grow through one system.

features.title: Lucky Minecarts
features.description: Two carts move above the reels; a leprechaun appearance activates a cart, which collects Diamond values beneath its position.

features.title: Mega Blast
features.description: Two active carts meeting above one reel collect Diamonds from all five reels at once.

features.title: Mega Blast meter
features.description: During Free Spins, Lucky Clovers raise the Mega Blast multiplier through x2, x5, x10 and x25 and add extra spins, up to 30 in total.

intro: Telly Reels uses five reels and twenty lines in an old-television presentation. Three or more Scatters start 10 Free Spins, with a wheel selecting an extra feature before the start.
Separately, the player can fill a star bonus table for Telly Bonus Spins with five locked Wilds, while matching five sliders awards Mini Telly Bonus up to 10x.
wazdan-telly-reels.editorial: The Free Spins wheel, star table and slider bonus are three independent events. The game limit of 1400x should not be replaced with wheel multipliers x2/x3/x5.

features.title: Wheel of Fortune before Free Spins
features.description: The wheel can add 5/10 spins, x2/x3/x5, 3–5 random Wilds or an Infinite Multiplier.

features.title: Telly Bonus Spins with five Wilds
features.description: A full star table opens 10 bonus spins with Wilds locked at slider positions.

features.title: Mini Telly Bonus up to 10x
features.description: Aligning all five sliders awards a separate random payout.

intro: Leprechaun's Vault uses a classic 5×3 grid, but its Free Spins count is not fixed beforehand. Individual vault-door code digits add together to determine bonus-sequence duration.
Inside the vault, the three centre reels turn gold. Wilds landing on them become Sticky Wilds and stay until Free Spins ends, while individual Wilds can carry multipliers.
playn-go-leprechauns-vault.editorial: The key moment here is the starting code configuration rather than bonus entry itself: it sets the spin count, after which Sticky Wilds gradually change the three centre reels.

features.title: Vault code
features.description: Door numbers add into the total Free Spins count, so the sequence can begin with varying durations.

features.title: Sticky Wild
features.description: Wilds on the three golden centre reels lock at their positions until the bonus ends.

features.title: Wild Multipliers
features.description: During the bonus sequence, Wilds can arrive with multipliers and enhance winning combinations in which they participate.

intro: Throne of Elements: Platinum builds its bonus around a 25-position matrix with twelve additional cells opening gradually. Guardian symbols in the middle row activate new reels.
Hold the Jackpot activates through a symbol on the centre reel or fully revealing Guardian. Cash Infinity retains values, while Cash Out pays Mystery Cash when a countdown finishes.
wazdan-throne-of-elements-platinum.editorial: The two Hold the Jackpot trigger routes should not be confused with bonus purchase. Grand 2500x refers to the full jackpot, while x10 Chance Level means bet size.

features.title: Guardian opens extra cells
features.description: Middle-row symbols expand the matrix, gradually activating twelve positions.

features.title: Two Hold the Jackpot entry routes
features.description: The mode can start through a centre symbol or a sufficient number of activated Guardians.

features.title: Cash Out and Cash Infinity
features.description: Some symbols persist until the bonus ends, while others become a payout after a countdown.

intro: Lion Saga Odyssey runs on a 5×3 grid with 10 lines. Three or more Scatters trigger 8 Free Spins, while additional Scatters can repeatedly extend the sequence until the overall win limit.
Before the bonus, one regular symbol is selected as the Special Expanding Symbol. During Free Spins, it expands across an entire reel if enough symbols are present for a standard winning combination.
playn-go-lion-saga-odyssey.editorial: Lion Saga Odyssey uses a familiar expanding-symbol formula, but its selected special symbol remains the same throughout the bonus sequence. This matters more than visual similarities to other adventure slots.

features.title: 8 Free Spins
features.description: Three or more Scatters trigger eight free spins; new Scatters can extend the bonus.

features.title: Special Expanding Symbol
features.description: One regular symbol is selected before the bonus and expands across a whole reel when enough are present for a winning combination.

features.title: Retrigger
features.description: Additional Scatters during Free Spins add spins until the game's overall win limit is reached.

intro: Triple Star uses five reels and twenty lines, with a special three-star symbol appearing only on the second, third and fourth reels.
On landing, this Wild expands across the whole column and triggers one free Respin with the expanded Wild locked, offering a chance to complete a combination.
wazdan-triple-star.editorial: The Triple Star Wild does not appear on the first or fifth reels. This matters more than the general retro-space theme: expansion and Respin are strictly limited to the centre columns.

features.title: Wild on reels 2–4
features.description: The three-star symbol substitutes for regular symbols only on the permitted centre reels.

features.title: Full-reel expansion
features.description: A landed Wild can cover the whole column, increasing qualifying lines.

features.title: One free Respin
features.description: The expanded column remains locked during the additional spin.

intro: Loot & Labyrinths adds Random Encounter to the base game: a special symbol on the first reel triggers one of three events, while symbols in the same row form the encounter parameters.

In Monster Attack, Treasure Lair and Tavern Night, a dice roll determines the outcome and multiplier. A critical result of 20 enhances the award, while three Scatters open separate Dungeon Free Spins.
playn-go-loot-and-labyrinths.editorial: Base-game mini-games and Dungeon Free Spins use different systems. Random Encounter depends on the row and dice roll, while the bonus centres on preselected enhancements and Attack Icon accumulation.

features.title: Random Encounter
features.description: A special symbol on the first reel triggers Monster Attack, Treasure Lair or Tavern Night, each with separate risk and reward rules.

features.title: Critical roll
features.description: A result of 20 counts as critical and can increase the award multiplier from x2 up to x5.

features.title: Dungeon Free Spins
features.description: Three Scatters open the bonus: three enhancements are selected before the start, while Attack Icons during the sequence advance the overall multiplier through x2, x5, x20 and x100.
